feed.text: Ulan has arrived on the island.

eventDeck.title: Hailstorm
eventDeck.blurb: Hail is flattening the orchard. Picking brings in a third of the usual harvest.

eventDeck.title: Bumper crop
eventDeck.blurb: The branches are bending to the ground. Picking brings in double.

eventDeck.title: Forest fire
eventDeck.blurb: Half the forest is smoke. Chopping brings in a third.

eventDeck.title: Cold snap
eventDeck.blurb: Every fire burns three times the wood.

eventDeck.title: Blight
eventDeck.blurb: Every larder rots tonight. All stored apples are lost.

eventDeck.title: Crow heist
eventDeck.blurb: Organised crows take 3 apples from every villager.

eventDeck.title: Surprise tax
eventDeck.blurb: The three richest villagers each hand a fifth of their coins to the three poorest.

eventDeck.title: Golden season
eventDeck.blurb: Everything grows. Picking and chopping bring in half as much again.

strategies.planner: does the sums and takes whatever pays best right now
strategies.contrarian: does whatever the fewest villagers did last round
strategies.trend: chases whatever the most villagers did last round
strategies.landlord: builds houses as early as possible and lives off the rent
strategies.specialist: sticks to the one job they are talented at, whatever the price
strategies.netmaker: weaves baskets to sell, and picks apples with one in between
strategies.copycat: copies whatever the current leader did last round
